analysis: The only change in this PR is a documentation edit to docs/architecture/inference.md. It adds one table row at head line 1389 for `decodeStepsBetweenPrefillChunks`: 4 for the Qwen 3.5 family, 0 otherwise. The two units supplied are base text at lines 1612-2422. They are unchanged surrounding context and do not contain the added row. I read both units and the patch. No executable code, config, authorization, attestation, encryption, cache, or coordinator-protocol behavior is changed in what I was given. The row describes an engine scheduling knob that interleaves decode steps between prefill chunks for Qwen 3.5 models. A security-relevant effect would be availability or latency, for example with respect to T-010, T-029 and the TTFT timing channel in T-041. That would depend on `EngineV2Factory+Configuration.swift`, `qwenDecodeStepsBetweenPrefillChunks`, which is not supplied, so I cannot verify it here. This is a coverage limit, not evidence of a regression. The base text I reviewed describes MTP, SSD prefix-cache identity, sampling, and the MiMo native paths. All of it is pre-existing and not modified, so I raise no new findings on it. The accompanying source change for the new knob, if any, belongs in another review batch. That review should check whether interleaving decode with prefill changes cancellation propagation, memory-reservation or KV accounting, or prefix-cache donation timing. Any such effect is not established by this docs diff.
